game.sourceDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256(path + NUL + UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF + NUL), in documented source order

publicState.probes: q64 only: 61 explicit synthetic booleans generated from request-call index only; q3 omits state.probes even if supplied in builder input

systemOne.questionCountMeaning: --questions 3|64 is the number of questions in one request only; it never limits dispatch count

q64.probeInstructionTemplate: state.probes[i] の値はtrueですか。trueなら1、falseなら0に対応する数値で回答してください。説明文は出力しないでください。

systemOne.actionInstructionExact: 画面は横800×縦360、地面はy=278。playerの固定boxはx=116,width=34,height=42。player.yは地面からの高さで上向きが正、vyも上向きが正。obstacles[].xは画面左端、width/heightはbox寸法です。この可視状態だけから次の操作を1つ選んでください。heldは維持されます。jump上限はstate.player.maxJumpsです（標準設定は2回）。2回目のjumpにはreleaseしてからjumpを再pressします。着地すると回数が戻ります。
systemOne.responseValidation: answers keys must exactly match q3/q64; required values are type/value checked. Top-level model/usage/measurements and per-answer type/probabilities metadata are allowed. Generated text/rationale is rejected.

rawRetention.rawResponse: exact complete HTTP response body string; metadata is not stripped or synthesized
rawRetention.forwardEvidence: Production server hook on the actual neural backend records neural_forward_calls and input_ids shapes in neural_forward_batches; CPU fixture forward_performed/device is not production evidence.
rawRetention.hardwareDevicePassthrough: metadata.hardware is preserved as supplied; if it has a device field it remains at report.hardware.device and report.metadata.hardware.device; the CLI does not invent or normalize GPU identity

timing.maxSecondsCli: positive values up to 30; production invocation is 30
timing.clockGapResult: invalid frame_gap; no catch-up gap is discarded or hidden

lateReply.meaning: valid measured reply arrived after terminal; distinct from missing/unmeasured and never applied as an action

systemOne.invalidAnswers: missing/malformed answers record invalid_response/error, action=null, applicationTick=null, no action/inputLog/release; physics continues

timeline.frameSnapshots: array of {tick,state}, one per physical tick from 1 through finalTick
timeline.inputLogs: Engine jump/release events only; event.tick=N is the state tick before stepping to N+1, applicationTick=N+1; legacy replayRecord consumes input.tick=N
timeline.actions: decision application rows including wait; wait is a no-op preserving held and is excluded from inputLogs
timeline.finalSnapshotHash: engine hash(JSON.stringify(private Engine.snapshot())); private snapshot is not exported

baselineRows.remote: each tick-16 opportunity has a decision; request_outstanding is also represented in skips
baselineRows.rule: local decision rows have rawRequest/rawResponse null; applied wait/jump/release are represented in actions, with only jump/release in inputLogs
baselineRows.idle: idle_no_action decision row plus skips.reason=idle_baseline at each tick-16 opportunity

terminalSemantics.collision: validated through existing dist/engine.js replayRecord; eligible collision runs may enter summarize
terminalSemantics.time_limit: censored; validated by scripts/verify-decision-trace.mjs; never passed to replayRecord/summarize
terminalSemantics.frame_gap: invalid run in runtimeGameInvalidErrors; never treated as clear/collision

result.provenance: metadata file is preserved as metadata and its model, hardware, and gameCommit values are also exposed at report top level; game.commit and game.sourceDigest identify the measurement code

cli.remote: node scripts/decision-bench.mjs --agent remote --seeds 101 --questions 64 --max-seconds 30 --max-jumps 2 --model MODEL --url http://127.0.0.1:8780/v1/systemone --metadata metadata.json --output artifacts/decision-bench/q64/seed-101/MODEL.json --trace
cli.validatorRule: all files in one invocation must share q3 or q64; production video sets require nine homogeneous questionCount traces

checks: synthetic boolean probes and true-value wording
real HTTP CPU fake server with model/usage/measurements and typed answer metadata

videoAlignment.measurementFreezeGate: do not wait for app replay/capture helper; video consumes this committed CLI schema as-is
videoAlignment.coldFirstGate: require late_answer_not_applied plus intact rawResponse/rawProbabilities, null applicationTick, and actual neural-forward evidence in rawResponse.measurements

freeze.recordingPlayer: separate later capture-integration change; no measurement CLI/source edits required after measurementCommit
freeze.sourceDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256(path + NUL + UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF + NUL), in documented source order

action.instructions: 画面は横800×縦360、地面はy=278。playerの固定boxはx=116,width=34,height=42。player.yは地面からの高さで上向きが正、vyも上向きが正。obstacles[].xは画面左端、width/heightはbox寸法です。この可視状態だけから次の操作を1つ選んでください。heldは維持されます。jump上限はstate.player.maxJumpsです（標準設定は2回）。2回目のjumpにはreleaseしてからjumpを再pressします。着地すると回数が戻ります。

criteria.wait: ジャンプ入力を新しく押さず、現在のheld状態を維持する。
criteria.jump: ジャンプ入力を押す。held中や上限到達中は受理されない場合があります。

commit.instructions: 選んだ操作を実行する意思の強さを数値で示してください。説明文は出力しないでください。

danger.instructions: この可視状態で操作を選ぶ危険度を3段階で評価してください。
